capabilities: Run strategy rules on historical prices
Compare results with buy and hold
Sweep parameters and check whether results are luck
List today's orders across the vault
disambiguation: Not a general code-block tester; it only runs trading rules against market prices.
extras: The plugin never places orders; you place trades yourself. It is not financial advice. Full guide and recipes live in docs/reference.md and docs/cookbook.md, and phone layouts were only checked in mobile emulation.
problem: A note can hold a trading idea, but there is no way to test those rules on historical prices without leaving the vault for a separate backtesting tool.

relations.evidence: data-api.binance.vision: Binance prices, and its list of markets
tiingo:SPY | Tiingo (an API key is necessary)
To add it to Claude Code:

summary: Runs trading-strategy rules written in a note against past prices and shows the backtest, figures and chart in place of the block.
